AIASSET_ENABLE_REAL_PROVIDERS.description: Master switch. "1" enables real Meshy calls; "0" forces the quota-safe mock path.

MESHY_API_KEY.description: Meshy API key. Empty string clears it.

MESHY_BASE_URL.description: Meshy base URL (address, not a secret). Empty string clears it.

COS_SECRET_ID.description: Tencent COS SecretId. Empty string clears it.

COS_SECRET_KEY.description: Tencent COS SecretKey. Empty string clears it.

COS_BUCKET.description: COS bucket (address). Empty string clears it.

COS_REGION.description: COS region (address). Empty string clears it.

slug.description: Active game slug auto-injected by the host; not a credential and dropped by the whitelist.
